apps.name: BYD Sea Lion 06
apps.localizedDescription: Компаньйон для BYD Sea Lion 06: стан авто, клімат, сидіння, камери.

versions.localizedDescription:
**Update the head unit together with the companion apps and the HA card.** A phone or card with this change sends
enveloped commands, which an older head unit ignores as unknown, so such a command gets «Авто не відповіло».

### Added
- **Wi-Fi hotspot kept on** (Налаштування → Фонова робота → «Точка доступу Wi-Fi», «Тримати завжди увімкненою», off by
  default). BYD switches the car's hotspot off and never restores it; a shell-UID helper (`byd_poc_hotspot`, independent
  of the keep-alive) starts it again while the head unit is awake with the ignition on, with BYD's stored SSID and
  passphrase. The state and the switch are published (`hotspot_on`, `hotspot_always_on`, `hotspot/always_on/set`) and
  shown as HA entities. The companion apps get a block «Авто» in Налаштування (state, confirmed switch, answer
  «Авто не відповіло» after 10 s); the HA card has no hotspot UI on purpose. Not yet verified on the car: the real start,
  the 600 s idle restart, the LTE upstream (`docs/ADB_QUEUE.md`, `openspec/changes/hotspot-always-on/`).
- **«Відновлювати ADB після перезапуску»** (Налаштування → Фонова робота, off by default), for BYD firmwares that close
  ADB port 5555 on every reboot («2606» builds, mid-2026). While ADB works, the app grants itself `WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS`.
  After a reboot it switches ADB back on through `adb_enabled`, or else through wireless debugging: `adb_wifi_enabled`,
  a TLS connection with the app's already trusted key, then `tcpip:5555`. It needs Wi-Fi, and «Always allow on this
  network» answered once per network, or the button «Довіряти цій Wi-Fi мережі» under the switch, which trusts the
  connected access point ahead of time through ADB itself. A status line under the switch says what it found
  (`openspec/changes/adb-restore-after-reboot/`). Tested on the car on 2026-11-15: port 5555 closed with `adb usb` was
  open again 54 s later.
- **The outside temperature in the companion apps and the HA card.** Головна shows the cabin and the outside temperature
  under the parked pill, Клімат shows the outside temperature under the cabin one, and Сидіння shows the two as
  side-by-side pairs (a missing outside value shows «—»). Sub-zero values use a true minus («−3°C»). The head unit
  already showed both (`openspec/changes/companion-exterior-temperature/`).
- **Every `/set` command gets an answer.** The phone apps and the HA card send window, child-lock, climate, seat and
  air-flow commands as `{"id","cmd"}`. The head unit answers once on `byd/sealion06/command/result` with `{"id","status"}`
  (`ok`, `rejected: moving`, `rejected: speed unknown`, `error: code <n>` and so on). The phones show «Чекаю відповіді
  авто…», then the outcome, and «Авто не відповіло» after 10 s without an answer; a refused climate tap goes back to the
  car's value. The head-unit Налаштування → Телеметрія tab lists the new topic «Відповіді на команди». Plain payloads
  (HA discovery buttons) still work, with no answer (`openspec/changes/command-acknowledgement/`).
- **Every command topic is acknowledged** is now a requirement (`openspec/specs/remote-commands`); `CLAUDE.md` has a
  section «Every `/set` command answers» that new commands must follow.

### Changed
- **«Фічі в роботі» dashboard shows what is left in each started change.** Every open task is listed with its kind of
  work (check, build, Figma, research, owner decision, docs) and an «авто» mark, and a started change gets a stage
  instead of plain «В роботі»: «Доробка», «Дизайн у Figma», «Чекає рішення», «Дотестувати на авто», «Дотестувати» or
  «Готово до архіву»; a blocked dead end is «Тупик» (`scripts/features-dashboard/build.py`).
- **A/C AUTO checked on the car.** From the phone and HA (`auto:off` / `auto:on` on `climate/set`, 2026-11-13 13:10) and
  from the head unit's Дашборд (2026-11-13 evening), the car's own A/C screen switched AUTO off and back on, and the
  toggle followed within ~5 s. Known gap: after any climate press the Дашборд card ignores presses for ~
